title: Assessing Demographic Bias in Named Entity Recognition

bias_targets.methodology: Using counterfactual name substitution in sentence templates (generated from Winogender and CoNLL datasets) with names predominantly associated with Black, White, and Hispanic demographics to measure and compare Named Entity Recognition (NER) model accuracy and confidence.
Using counterfactual name substitution in sentence templates with predominantly male and female names to measure and compare the accuracy and confidence of Named Entity Recognition (NER) models.

Using counterfactual name substitution in sentence templates with names predominantly associated with the Muslim demographic to measure and compare the accuracy and confidence of Named Entity Recognition (NER) models.
